# WildFly Ecosystem AI Context Hub

> This is the global index for the WildFly ecosystem, covering core server runtime, full application server distribution, provisioning tooling, and cross-cutting architectural guidance. Agents and LLMs should use this file as the primary entry point for navigating WildFly's multi-repository codebase. Each satellite repository maintains its own `llms.txt` with component-level detail; this hub links them together and provides ecosystem-wide context that no single repository owns.

## Core & Runtime Repositories

- [WildFly Core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kabir/wildfly-core/ai-index/llms.txt): Core server management model, controller, CLI, and subsystem parsing. Defines the kernel runtime, management resource tree, operation handlers, deployment scanner SPI, and the Remoting-based management protocol. All subsystems in wildfly-core are boot-critical and available in both standalone and domain mode.
- [WildFly Full](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kabir/wildfly/ai-index/docs/src/main/asciidoc/llms.txt): Full application server, Jakarta EE subsystem guides, security, HA, and deployment. Extends wildfly-core with Jakarta EE specifications (Servlet, EJB, JPA, JMS, CDI, JAX-RS, MicroProfile), clustering, Elytron security integration, and the complete distribution packaging.

## Ecosystem Tooling

- [WildFly Maven Plugin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kabir/wildfly-maven-plugin/ai-index/llms.txt): Developer-facing Maven build tooling for provisioning, packaging, deploying, and running WildFly servers. Provides 15 Maven goals including Galleon-based server provisioning, Bootable JAR packaging, container image building, dev-mode with hot-reload, and CLI script execution. Integrates WildFly Glow for automatic discovery of required feature packs and layers via `<discover-provisioning-info/>`.

## Ecosystem Tooling (Placeholders/Future)

- WildFly Glow: Provisioning analysis engine that inspects application archives to determine the minimal set of Galleon feature packs and layers required. Repository index will be linked once the ai-index branch is established.
- WildFly Operator: Kubernetes operator for managing WildFly application deployments on OpenShift and vanilla Kubernetes. Handles StatefulSet orchestration, session draining, and transaction recovery. Repository index forthcoming.

## Global Architecture & Contracts

- [Ecosystem Topology](./architecture/ecosystem-topology.md): Component relationships and execution flow across repositories. Documents the hierarchy from core runtime through full distribution to provisioning and deployment tooling.
- [Repository Boundaries](./architecture/repository-boundaries.md): SPI boundaries and dependency rules between Core, WildFly, and provisioning tools. Defines what belongs where and the contract versioning discipline that keeps repositories independently releasable.
- [ADR 0001: Hub-and-Spoke AI Context](./adrs/0001-hub-and-spoke-ai-context.md): Architectural Decision Record for the multi-repo AI context model. Explains why a federated index approach was chosen over monolithic context dumps or per-query repository crawling.
